Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: Family's refuel setup sheet sequence - from the light settings list, a bottom sheet steps through "Choose Chains" (Base, Optimism, Arbitrum, Polygon toggles), "Choose Amount" ($2-$50/Custom pills), "Custom Amount" (numpad), "Review Details" (per-chain rows, $36 total), "Refuel Address", and "Refuel Gas" (bolt, "1 transaction required", Cancel / Confirm) - the container fluidly resizing to each step.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Light "Your Family" settings list behind. Sheet steps: "Choose Chains" (chain rows with blue circle-check toggles, Continue); "Choose Amount" (six pills: $2, $5, $10, $20, $50, Custom - $5 selected with blue ring); "Custom Amount" (big "$0", numpad); "Review Details" (Refuel header, Base/Optimism/Arbitrum rows $12 each, "Pay with Ethereum", total "0.00136 ETH $36", Continue); "Refuel Address" (ENS or address field, Paste button, avatar placeholder); "Refuel Gas" (yellow bolt, "To finish your refuel, review and confirm the transaction below", blue "1 transaction required" banner, "$36 / 0 ETH", "$0.29 Normal" fee, Cancel / blue Confirm).

## Motion spec
Pattern: height-morphing sheet across a six-step flow.
- Entrance: sheet slides up (spring ~300/20) over the dimmed list (scrim 40%).
- Each step: the outgoing content slides up and fades (150ms, 30ms stagger on rows) while the sheet's height springs to the incoming step (spring ~280/22, 300ms); the new content rises with a 50ms-per-row stagger.
- The blue Continue persists bottom-anchored through steps 1-4, its label/enabled state crossfading (200ms); on the final step it divides into the Cancel / Confirm pair (width ease 250ms).
- The numpad step pairs the sheet with the keyboard (lockstep 250ms).
- Chain toggles and amount pills animate selection instantly (ring draw 100ms, check pop spring ~340/16).

## Calibration
- Sheet width and radius never change - height and content only.
- Every step's title crossfades in place at the same header slot.

## Reduced motion
Steps crossfade (200ms) at eased heights; no staggers.

## Don't miss
- "Review Details" shows three chain rows at $12 each summing to $36 - the math is visible.
- The final sheet's fee "$0.29 Normal" sits beside the $36 total.
